title: Yellow Citrusy Jamaican Tofu Stir fry
description: A briny and pillowy Jamaican dish featuring yuzu-kosho, perfect for a lazy Sunday, this macrobiotic-friendly stir-fry is a twist on traditional Jamaican cuisine.

ingredients.name: extra firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into small cubes

instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the tofu and cook until golden brown on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the tofu from the skillet and set aside.
Add the scallions, garlic, and ginger to the skillet and cook until the scallions are softened, about 3 minutes.
Add the yuzu kosho, jamaican jerk seasoning, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the yellow bell pepper to the skillet and cook until tender, about 3 minutes.
Return the tofu to the skillet and stir to combine with the vegetables and seasonings.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes, stirring constantly, until the tofu is well coated with the seasonings.
Stir in the chopped cilantro and serve hot.
